 AIIMS INICET 2026 Exam on November 1: Documents Required, Entry Rules and Guidelines
 AIIMS New Delhi will conduct the INI CET 2026 on November 1 for the January 2027 postgraduate session. Admit cards were released on October 26, 2026. Candidates must bring their printed hall ticket, valid original photo ID, and complete identity verification at the designated exam centre. Roshni Yadav 30 Oct, 2026 Share

 Important Exam Day Guidelines 
 The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, will conduct the Institute of National Importance Combined Entrance Test (INI CET) 2026 on November 1. This entrance test provides admission into MD, MS, MDS, DM, and MCh programmes across participating institutes. Candidates must review the AIIMS INI CET November 2026: Exam Day Instructions, Documents and Entry Rules to ensure seamless entry into the examination centre. The official admit cards became available on October 26, 2026, on the official portal aiimsexams.ac.in .
 Candidates can also check the INI CET January 2027 exam date and schedule for details about the examination timeline and admission session.

 Candidates can refer to the INI CET November 2026 Admit Card update to understand the hall ticket release and download process.
 Mandatory Documents for Exam Day
 Candidates must bring essential verification items to gain entry to the test centre. Physical verification is mandatory for every applicant.
 Admit Card: A clear printout of the INI CET January 2027 admit card with the required declaration completed and signed as instructed. Digital copies on mobile phones are strictly not permitted.
 Photo Identification: An original and valid identity document accepted under official examination instructions.
 Verification Process: Candidates must cooperate with the examination staff during frisking, identity checks, and biometric or iris verification.
 Detail Verification: Verify that name, candidate details, examination centre address, and reporting time mentioned on the hall ticket match the official ID.
 Candidates who need help understanding the hall ticket can refer to the INI CET Admit Card 2026 download guide , which explains the release details and steps to access the document.
 Prohibited Items and Venue Regulations
 Examination centres enforce strict entry rules. Candidates must avoid carrying restricted items to prevent delays or disqualification:
 Electronic Devices: Mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices, and other unauthorized electronic gadgets.
 Study Materials: Books, paper notes, calculators, and other prohibited study materials.
 Stationery & Personal Items: Personal stationery or unapproved personal belongings inside the examination hall.
 Candidates can also review the INI CET 2026 exam pattern and marking scheme to understand the computer-based examination format and restrictions, including the use of calculators.
 Important Exam Day Guidelines
 Candidates should follow these official exam day instructions for a smooth process:
 Advance Planning: Plan travel in advance and arrive well before the reporting time to allow adequate time for traffic clearance, security checks, and identity verification.
 Gate Closing Rules: Entry will not be permitted under any circumstances after the specified closing time.
 Centre Address Verification: Check the exact centre address mentioned on the admit card rather than relying only on examination city information.
 Hall Ticket Integrity: Ensure the printed hall ticket is intact, clear, and complete with all required declarations.
 AIIMS INI CET November 2026 FAQs
 When will the AIIMS INI CET 2026 examination be conducted?
 AIIMS will conduct the INI CET 2026 examination on November 1, 2026, for admission to the January 2027 session. What documents are required for the INI CET 2026 exam?
 Candidates must carry a printed copy of their INI CET admit card and an original, valid photo ID accepted under the official examination instructions. Which items are prohibited inside the INI CET 2026 examination centre?
 Mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, books, paper notes, and other unauthorised electronic gadgets or study materials are prohibited. Can candidates enter the INI CET examination centre after the gate-closing time?
 No. Candidates will not be allowed to enter after the specified gate-closing time. They should check the reporting time and entry instructions on their admit cards and reach the examination centre early. Have questions about your prep?
